ValidationRule.description: Revenue, expenses, balances, and debt service cannot be negative. Net income is exempt.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( Revenue__c < 0, Interest_Expense__c < 0, Income_Tax_Expense__c < 0, Depreciation_Amortization__c < 0, Annual_Debt_Service__c < 0, Total_Assets__c < 0, Total_Liabilities__c < 0 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only net income can be negative. Check revenue, expenses, assets, liabilities, and debt service.
